hero.heading: Build systems that have to work
hero.description: We hire engineers who want production responsibility, not handoffs. At Ternary you stay close to users, own what you ship, and grow inside a centralized engineering institution built to develop talent over the long term.

section_2.heading: How we work
section_2.description: Our culture is shaped by the realities of building and sustaining sophisticated systems. We work with low noise, close proximity to users, and a clear orientation toward impact.

item_1.heading: Ownership and stewardship
item_1.description: We take responsibility for the systems we design, deliver, and operate. Engineering here is long-term stewardship, with care for reliability, maintainability, and the consequences of decisions over time.

item_2.heading: Transparency and low-noise execution
item_2.description: We value direct communication, visible progress, and clear escalation when needed. Problems are surfaced early, tradeoffs are made explicit, and execution stays focused on outcomes rather than noise.

item_3.heading: Proximity to users and impact
item_3.description: We stay close to the people and operations our systems serve. Maintaining proximity to users and real-world workflows lets us build with context and deliver work that has lasting operational impact.

item_4.heading: Production responsibility, end to end
item_4.description: Engineers maintain long-horizon responsibility for the code they write, supporting deployments and remaining accountable for sustained system performance across the lifecycle.

item_5.heading: Built as stewards, not just builders
item_5.description: We see ourselves as stewards and enablers, responsible for creating systems that perform reliably, evolve thoughtfully, and serve the organizations that depend on them.

item_6.heading: One centralized institution
item_6.description: A unified center of engineering excellence creates operational continuity, preserves institutional knowledge, and gives every engineer shared standards to grow against.

section_3.heading: What you can expect
section_3.description: We invest in the foundational systems of durable engineering excellence so you can do the best work of your career.

item_1.heading: Real mentorship
item_1.description: Structured mentorship and experienced technical leadership with clear expectations around accountability, code quality, and professional growth.

item_2.heading: Rigorous training
item_2.description: We identify high-potential talent early and develop it systematically through technical training and engineering standards aligned to long-term quality.

item_3.heading: Work that matters
item_3.description: You ship production systems for organizations that depend on them, from capital markets to digital health to field service, not throwaway prototypes.

item_4.heading: A clear path forward
item_4.description: Career progression frameworks and leadership development give you a defined route from associate engineer to technical lead and beyond.

section_4.heading: Engineering growth
section_4.description: We develop engineers along a clear progression, pairing rising technical depth with expanding ownership and delivery responsibility.

item_1.heading: A defined career ladder
item_1.description: Move from associate to lead on the strength of your craft, judgment, and the responsibility you can carry, with expectations made explicit at every step.

item_2.heading: Modern stacks
item_2.description: Build with Python, JavaScript, Java, and Go on the backend; React, Angular, and Vue on the frontend; and Flutter, Swift, and Kotlin on mobile.

item_3.heading: Full lifecycle exposure
item_3.description: Work across strategy, design, build, launch, and operation, so you understand systems end to end rather than just one slice.

item_4.heading: Delivery governance
item_4.description: Disciplined execution frameworks and delivery governance teach you to ship at scale with consistency and control.

item_5.heading: Global delivery hub
item_5.description: Grow inside our Dhaka delivery hub, the core engineering capability for the organizations we support worldwide.

team.heading: Team voices. Production stories.
team.description: Meet the engineers and operators who ship the technical and commercial infrastructure behind modern enterprise.

jobs.heading: Open roles
jobs.description: We hire across engineering, design, and operations in New York and Dhaka. If you want production responsibility and a real path to grow, we want to hear from you, even when the exact role isn't listed.
